source_candidates.precondition: The loaded vehicle has nonempty make/model and a searchable plate or descriptor.
source_candidates.source_inference: VehicleLabel prefers make/model over plate/descriptor, while VehiclesPage filters only this derived label even though search input promises plate or descriptor.
source_candidates.limits: Loaded-page-only search is explicit; no server authority or tenant leak, and no browser reproduction was executed.

source_candidates.source_inference: Test title claims oversized JPEG rejection, but its only two mocked invalid arrays are a short non-JPEG and a truncated JPEG; the actual 8MiB limit is implemented but not tested by that assertion.
source_candidates.limits: No source evidence oversized files are accepted in production, and no test was executed.

source_candidates.source_inference: The test pairs ascending distinct created_at values with already-sorted UUIDs and so never tests the ID tie-break under equal timestamps; production SQL explicitly orders by created_at,id.
source_candidates.limits: No production queue sorting failure demonstrated and no database suite was run.

source_candidates.source_inference: Two lock-race tests use fixed 100ms sleeps to assume a contender reached the intended wait point, rather than observing a precise PostgreSQL barrier.
source_candidates.limits: Tests also check single winner, authority and no unauthorized custody/audit side effects; flakiness and production race behavior were not observed.

source_candidates.source_inference: A 10-second pg_stat_activity wait loop has no delay/backoff between successive queries.
source_candidates.limits: This is test-only polling. No controlled DB load, test timeout failure or production resource exhaustion was measured.

source_candidates.source_inference: An onRefresh rejection propagates through a Promise.finally chain without a catch.
source_candidates.limits: No pinned production Native import was identified for NativeManualRefreshButton, only tests; no actual current-user invocation or runtime rejection demonstrated.

source_candidates.source_inference: Malformed timestamp would produce NaN and could throw in Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.
source_candidates.limits: Canonical StaffTaskQueueItem contract rejects malformed createdAt/retrievalRequestedAt, and no production path bypassing that contract was established.

source_candidates.source_inference: Employee Web root viewport declares maximumScale=1 and userScalable=false, preventing ordinary browser-controlled page pinch zoom on mobile implementations that honor those directives.
source_candidates.limits: Prime independently read full 38-line module. Browser/device zoom and screen-reader accessibility impact were not exercised. Late W5 records remain uncredited after the immutable fallback; official W1 record will separately cover the path.

source_candidates.source_inference: Visible label elements lack htmlFor/id relationships to the live plate input, region select, and customer phone input; these form controls lack equivalent explicit accessible-name attributes.
source_candidates.limits: Prime read full 64- and 188-line source modules. Dynamic accessibility tree, assistive technology outcome and browser validation were not executed; W2 assessed the plate case conservatively as P3, so final P2 severity is conditional.

source_candidates.source_inference: Vehicle condition submit sets isSubmitting, but condition Back/option controls are not disabled, allowing step/condition change while the pending completion mutation may later force parking-task step.
source_candidates.limits: No browser interleaving tested; lifecycle mutation has isSubmitting guard for duplicate submissions and backend authority unaffected.

qualification: All 175 formal C016 paths passed strict pinned-source record QA. Findings are source-only candidates, not runtime-confirmed production defects. Two P3 hypotheses are dormant or actively contract-mitigated; the overlapping label candidates from W5 supplemental and W2 official records count once. No product/runtime checks, UI fixes, or issue changes were authorized or performed.
